desc:
⭐ Welcome to Keyboard Car Slide +1 Speed! ⭐

👟 Train your car speed on colorful keyboards 
⚡ Slide across keyboards and cover the greatest distance possible.
🏆 Earn Wins based on the distance you travel
🌊 Upgrade your speed and cars
🌈 Collect unique Trails to level up twin as fast
🌎 Discover amazing keyboard themes and become the best car slider! 

🔥 Challenge your friends and other players. 
👑 Become the FASTEST player on the server! 
💥 Every point of speed counts... the faster you are, the further you'll go! 

🎵 Relaxing ASMR Experience
Enjoy satisfying keyboard sounds, smooth sliding, colorful visuals, and a relaxing atmosphere while trying to beat your next distance record!
